criteria.name: artwork_craft
criteria.why: Bold dark register on every frame; the cover, 7's column and 9's streak work. Four frames fall short: 4 a featureless rounded grey box; 6 a row of primitive discs and cylinders with six unexplained white discs, a dominant pale cost bar, the pole cropped and '$220' outside the safe zone; 2 the node hangs over the hill line with no contact and 'c18 c20' on a plate; 8's left half is empty black. On 3 the SOLAR PANEL leader crosses the PRECIPITATION leader.

criteria.name: deck_coherence
criteria.why: One night world with rain, one hero node in one material, one amber accent at the waterline; the camera move climbs the node. Slide 5 sits outside the world.

criteria.name: claim_integrity
criteria.why: Every numeral traces to a quote via compute.py. Defects: compute.py types release_date as a literal attributed to c1, whose quote carries no date; the first comment printed the year in a 2026 post; slides 8 and 9 show the node in a flood with no 'Drawn to illustrate' while 8's dek says no field test against a real flood exists; on 2 the kicker and the node drawn by the radar column invite a link no claim makes.

criteria.name: story_and_stakes
criteria.why: What happened, what it does and what is missing are clear, and the close gives a real action. The where is loose: the release's coastal target arrives only on 8 and in the caption's fourth paragraph. No body decides and no next date exists.

criteria.name: sequence_and_momentum
criteria.why: The cover is clear but mild, 2 pays at once, 3 to 6 run the device, the turn at 7 into 8, and 9 closes. 3 and 4 overlap; 5 could move.

criteria.name: voice
criteria.why: Clean and Texan; house rules clean on slides and caption. Flat lines: '98.82%, scored on data' and the slide 5 hook.

criteria.name: variety
criteria.why: No topic repeat in 30 days. The ninth consecutive one-hero deck, the second night world in four days, and the second release-absence spine in two days.

one_sentence_fix: Print 'Drawn to illustrate' on 8 and 9, take the release date from a published field on the fetched page rather than a typed literal, and rebuild the first comment so the date prints 'September 28th'.

artwork_weakest_frames.problem: A featureless rounded grey box fills half the frame.
artwork_weakest_frames.fix: Model the enclosure as hardware (latches, a dark gasket line, a gland with a drip loop, mud on the lower third) in a three-quarter view with the lamp raking the lid edge.

artwork_weakest_frames.problem: Untextured discs and cylinders, six unexplained white discs, a dominant pale cost bar, the pole cropped, '$220' outside the safe zone.
artwork_weakest_frames.fix: Lay out only the parts the release names as modelled heroes, drop the bar to mid grey, pull '$220' inside the margin.

artwork_weakest_frames.problem: The node hangs over the hill line with no contact; the footer id sits on a plate.
artwork_weakest_frames.fix: Put the node's footing on the far bank with contact and a reflection; darken the ground under the id instead of a plate.

artwork_weakest_frames.problem: The left half is empty black with no ground, water or horizon.
artwork_weakest_frames.fix: Lower the camera so the water plane runs the full width at the lower third with the rail mirrored and the lamp streak across it.
